content: RDNA3 CUDA-porting pitfalls: never assume warpSize 32 (HIP porting guide); RDNA3 HIP default wave64 but llama.cpp ROCm path reports Wave Size 32 while Vulkan uses 64 - backend inconsistency; ggml assumes wave size 32 everywhere (PR#11495); __AMDGCN_WAVEFRONT_SIZE macro deprecated; RDNA3 WMMA is wave-cooperative 16x16x16 with fragment layouts unlike CUDA mma - use rocWMMA; rocWMMA FlashAttention caused -41 percent prefill regression on gfx1151 (llama.cpp#24437) and compile breaks on gfx1201 with ROCm 6.4 (#13110); occupancy limited by VGPR/SGPR/LDS per CU; LDS bank conflict rate measurable via rocprofiler-compute; HIPRTC can overallocate ~45KB LDS killing occupancy (#3806).
